decisions.statement: A value already in the global dictionary is left out of the local dictionary.
A value is counted only from the third time that value is met.
A whole number between zero and one hundred is too short to be worth an index.
A string or a number running to two characters at most is too short to be worth an index.
The dictionary is ordered from the value met most often down to the value met least.
A key of an array is skipped rather than counted.

definition: the repeated values of a table gathered so each is written out once
